environment.provenance: existing private environment inventory, no installation or upgrade

model.readiness: loader source supports config-driven MLX quantization and Llama; actual load/output verification still required
model.dflash: Installed model-settings source excludes Llama from supported DFlash families. The ordinary 135M autoregressive draft is not a DFlash checkpoint; do not pretend disabling an available trained DFlash advantage.

protocol.prompt_schema: string or list of strings; not token ID array
protocol.input: Render one exact frozen target chat template once, pass the same rendered string to all frameworks; audit prompt token IDs at scheduler admission and reject mismatches before timing. Do not assume equal strings guarantee equal BOS behavior.
protocol.eos: No ignore_eos or min_tokens field in official CompletionRequest. Scheduler always merges tokenizer/generation EOS; stop=[] does not disable EOS. Use identical natural EOS and max_tokens ceilings for all service arms, report actual emitted token counts. Forced-length DS traces are mechanism evidence, not a directly comparable service speedup.
protocol.timing: Fixed absolute arrival schedule shared across arms, including 1/2/4 concurrency and both long-first/short-first. Measure submission-to-first-token, intertoken arrival, complete task, errors and timeouts. Include queue and SSE transport time.

configuration.launch_validation: Flags verified from installed CLI help captured by prior audit, not executed in this audit. Isolated parent contains only target snapshot; own free port must not be 8765. Settings/cache directories must be isolated before execution.
configuration.cache: Do not disable cache solely to win. Cold arm uses fresh isolated process/cache and audited actual cached_tokens; warm reuse separately keeps reasonable native cache enabled. --no-cache only disables oMLX paged SSD cache, not internal BatchGenerator KV; if used as mechanism control label it explicitly.
configuration.prefill: Installed SchedulerConfig prefill_step_size default 2048 and max_num_seqs default 256; CLI max-concurrent-requests exists. No verified CLI prefill-step flag; inspect resulting runtime config instead of inventing one. Allow independent reasonable development tuning under equal total resource caps.
configuration.native_batch: Use installed BatchGenerator(model, max_tokens=..., stop_tokens=..., completion_batch_size=..., prefill_batch_size=..., prefill_step_size=...) and insert plus next() ticks. Admit the same frozen arrivals at tick boundaries and record lateness; next_generated() may conceal prefill ticks. Service fairness also requires equal HTTP/SSE observation, not direct Python native vs HTTP oMLX.

resources.allocation: One GPU-owning process at a time; no parallel model services. Preflight available memory before loading, retain balanced guard and system Metal limit.
resources.kv_estimate: 360M config: 32 layers * 2 K/V * 5 KV heads * 64 head dim * 2 BF16 bytes = 40960 bytes/token, approximately 320 MiB for four 2048-token requests before padding/overhead. Actual cache dtype/allocator must be measured.
resources.total: Target weights + KV + activations/logits + framework/runtime reserve, not KV alone; reuse 2 GiB adapter reserve as conservative planning, not measured oMLX requirement. Record available memory, process RSS, actual Metal peak and swap before/during/after, reject resource-contaminated rounds.

acceptance_before_comparison: Actual small-target oMLX load and deterministic output audit
Natural EOS semantics aligned with DeepInfer and native controls
Version/source/settings hash frozen after development tuning
At least three independent process rounds with rotating framework order and heldout tasks
Cold/warm cache separate; failures and resource exclusions retained
No extrapolation from 360M dense to 9B or hybrid models
